# lukax/llms-txt-action

> A GitHub Action that generates, commits, checks and reports on llms.txt files for websites, docs and repositories using the llms.ink API.

The action modes include write, commit, pr, check, comment, aeo, context, inspect and indexnow. Commits and pull requests made with the default GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger other workflows.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukax/llms-txt-action/HEAD/README.md)
